[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 120
- Description: Oracle site — fix excess vertical whitespace in hexagram readings (print + mobile)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/oracle/pull/73
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/oracle/pull/74
  
  Details:
  Autopilot (Sophia) work on oracle.truesight.me print-mode and mobile-view whitespace in the hexagram reading boxes.
  
  Scope: diagnosed and fixed excess vertical white space in the primary + relating hexagram reading boxes, both in print mode and in mobile view.
  
  PRs merged (TrueSightDAO/oracle):
  - #73 — Fix excess vertical whitespace in print mode (primary + relating hexagram). Root cause: syncHexagramHeights() pins inline min-height on .hexagram-card / .hexagram-info-block from the on-screen layout; @media print never reset them, and printing at paper width reflows the cards so the pins no longer matched content. Fix: reset pins with !important in @media print + skip syncing while matchMedia("print") is active.
  - #74 — Remove excess vertical whitespace in hexagram reading boxes on mobile. Root cause: the same height-equalizer force-pads the shorter card up to the taller one's height, but on mobile the layout collapses to a single column so the cards are STACKED — equalizing them is pure dead space (~25-49px/card + ~25px/block). Fix: only equalize when the cards share a grid row (same offsetTop), checked inside the rAF after layout.
  
  Verification (headless Chrome, Playwright, against the LIVE site):
  - 390px mobile: pins cleared, natural heights 495/447 (was 495/496) — dead space gone.
  - 1100px desktop: pins intact 462/462 — even side-by-side cards preserved.
  Both fixes confirmed live on oracle.truesight.me (main HEAD ccda3c5f).
  
  Type: Time (Minutes) — estimate for the investigation + repro harness + fix + validation + deploy verification across the session. Governor may adjust.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 200.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
